court_answers.answer: fixed by commit 74c37f1: checkout/1 no longer ends in `else _ -> {nil, nil}`. It returns a typed probe (:ok | :absent | :no_checkout | :unborn | :git_failed) with repo_head_why; :no_checkout requires both a git failure and no `.git` in any ancestor (filesystem observation), :unborn requires symbolic-ref + show-ref exit 1, anything else keeps the typed git failure; git toplevel is cross-checked by inode against the nearest `.git` holder. committed_at_head for a :git_failed dir is null + the git failure, never false. The three named scenarios are covered by real-git tests: unborn HEAD (false + the unborn reason), corrupt .git/HEAD and a dir inside .git (null + the rev-parse failure), SHA-256 object format (64-hex repo_head, committed_at_head true). Dubious ownership reaches the same :git_failed branch (a `.git` exists, git refuses) but is not exercised: it needs a different file owner, which a test cannot create without root. Four mutants kill the new test (r2/mut-*.log).
